name: Mima Haruka
source: The first person Ikumi talked to on the way to the FARGO facility, Mima Haruka later revealed to Ikumi that her goal in joining FARGO was to seek her brother who is working there. A cool girl with an attitude, she was assigned to Class C [spoiler]due to her lack of traumatic experiences and as a result, she suffered through deplorable conditions but managed to preserve her sanity until at a later point[/spoiler]. She often picks on Yui and says funny comments about her, usually about her breasts' small size.
